bull_argument.argument:
TSMC August revenue rose 53.3% year on year and 10.1% month on month, offering recent evidence of foundry demand. Strong margins and modest gross leverage reinforce a growth case independent of converting unlabelled statement amounts into dollars.

Technical evidence is constructive, with price above major averages, positive momentum and RSI near 59. ADR and reporting-currency reconciliation is essential before precise valuation, but simultaneous demand and trend evidence supports a credible conditional buy case without invented targets. Statement periods and forward estimates remain undated, so conviction is conditional.

bear_argument.argument:
31.95x trailing and 19.76x forward earnings still require growth delivery after foundry reinvestment. Missing statement currency and ADR basis prevent reliable cross-currency valuation arithmetic.

Price above all major averages, positive histogram and RSI near 59 form the clearest constructive trend-following setup; the recent 444.29 high still needs a sustained break. A constructive technical setup can improve execution, but cannot resolve these valuation and funding questions. The bull case is conditional on further operating or financial confirmation; those conditions should gate new capital rather than be treated as facts already proved.
